pages.text: Partition entities with an entity filter, then run the corresponding accepted or fallback processor list.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Charge the branch each target takes; reserve the more expensive branch per target.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 + P + max(A,B) + 0.25*min(A,B), like a conditional branch.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)filter$(br)Filter / Insert one node$(br2)$(li)Accepted targets$(br)Effect / Add up to 64 nodes
